LCU fixed approvals for using a new app in the Claude app, which could hang for about 30 minutes. Fjord's Router now asks before splitting a message that speaks to several chats in turn.

journal.text: Fjord learned to split one message into parts for several Claude Code chats and send each where it belongs. LCU's computer use stopped breaking when the ChatGPT app updated itself.
Silo's engine can now be published as its own download, and a prebuilt copy can be re-signed and built into another app. Checks on who signed it were also tightened.
Fjord's window no longer closes when Esc is pressed. Highlights in its brief can now be marked read, archived or opened with the same keyboard shortcuts as the inbox.
Fjord learned to interrupt a running Claude Code session with a new message in one step. Silo stopped leaving imported Macs half set up when an account token could not be restored.
Silo gained control of computers on another device. Fjord gained a ⌘K search over sessions, inbox and settings, and can mute projects or stop a Claude Code session when asked in plain words.
Fjord Computer was renamed Fjord. Its window now opens and closes without first taking a picture of itself, and its idle CPU use fell from about 10% to 0.5%.

highlights.text: fix(macos): preserve Korean typeText via original paste

journal.text: Fjord gained search and can now cancel, or edit and resend, messages sent to Claude Code sessions. LCU stopped dropping accented letters, Korean and emoji when typing on macOS.
